
```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
```

```{python}
root = Path.cwd().parent.absolute()
```

Load data for one session
```{python}
sessions = list((root/"data").glob("ses*"))
ses = sessions[0]
spikes = pd.read_parquet(ses/"spikes.parquet")
stimuli = pd.read_parquet(ses/"stimuli.parquet")
n_stimuli = len(stimuli['start_time'])
```

Select spikes in V1 and pick a single unit
```{python}
spikes_v1 = spikes[spikes["brain_area"]=="V1"]
unit_id = pd.unique(spikes_v1["unit_id"])[0]
unit_spike_times = spikes_v1.loc[spikes_v1["unit_id"] == unit_id, "spike_time"].to_numpy()
unit_spike_times = np.sort(unit_spike_times)
```

For each stimulus, find the spikes in the window and get their relative times
```{python}
tmin, tmax = -0.2, 0.5
relative_spike_times = []
for t_stim in stimuli["start_time"]:
    window_start = t_stim + tmin
    window_end = t_stim  +tmax
    # Find spikes within the window
    start_idx = np.searchsorted(unit_spike_times, window_start, side='left')
    stop_idx = np.searchsorted(unit_spike_times, window_end, side='right')
    # compute spike times relative to stimulus and add them to list
    spikes_in_window = unit_spike_times[start_idx:stop_idx]
    relative_spike_times.extend(spikes_in_window-t_stim)
```


```{python}
# create bins
bin_size = 0.005
n_bins = int(np.ceil((tmax-tmin) / bin_size))
bins = np.linspace(tmin, tmax, n_bins + 1)
# count spikes per bin
counts, bin_edges = np.histogram(relative_spike_times, bins=bins)
bin_centers = (bin_edges[:-1] + bin_edges[1:]) / 2
# normalize to firing rate (Hz)
psth = counts / (n_stimuli * bin_size)
```


```{python}
plt.plot(bin_centers, psth)
plt.xlabel("Time [s]")
plt.ylabel("Firing Rate [Hz]")
plt.axvline(x=0, ymin=0, ymax=1, linestyle='--', color="black")
plt.axvline(x=0.25, ymin=0, ymax=1, linestyle='--', color="black")
```


Now do it for all units in V1
```{python}
unit_psths = []
for unit_id in pd.unique(spikes_v1["unit_id"]):
    unit_spike_times = spikes_v1.loc[spikes_v1["unit_id"] == unit_id, "spike_time"].to_numpy()
    unit_spike_times = np.sort(unit_spike_times)
    relative_spike_times = []
    for t_stim in stimuli["start_time"]:
        window_start = t_stim + tmin
        window_end = t_stim  +tmax
        # Find spikes within the window
        start_idx = np.searchsorted(unit_spike_times, window_start, side='left')
        stop_idx = np.searchsorted(unit_spike_times, window_end, side='right')
        # compute spike times relative to stimulus and add them to list
        spikes_in_window = unit_spike_times[start_idx:stop_idx]
        relative_spike_times.extend(spikes_in_window-t_stim)
    counts, bin_edges = np.histogram(relative_spike_times, bins=bins)
    unit_psths.append(counts / (n_stimuli * bin_size))
```

Plot all PSTHs
```{python}
for psth in unit_psths:
    plt.plot(bin_centers, psth, color="black", linewidth=0.5)
plt.xlabel("Time [s]")
plt.ylabel("Firing Rate [Hz]")
plt.axvline(x=0, ymin=0, ymax=1, linestyle='--', color="black")
plt.axvline(x=0.25, ymin=0, ymax=1, linestyle='--', color="black")
```

Plot the population mean PSTH
```{python}
mean_psth = np.mean(unit_psths, axis=0)
plt.plot(bin_centers, mean_psth)
plt.xlabel("Time [s]")
plt.ylabel("Firing Rate [Hz]")
plt.axvline(x=0, ymin=0, ymax=1, linestyle='--', color="black")
plt.axvline(x=0.25, ymin=0, ymax=1, linestyle='--', color="black")

```
